name: Akasha Domain
body:
This domain is almost identical to the original akasha domain, except that you gain the shape akasha domain power at 1st level instead and replace the blessing of essence domain power at 1st level with the soulfire bolt domain power at 4th level.

Soulfire Bolt (Sp)

At 4th level, you can use essence bolt as a spell-like ability with a standard action and you may burn essence normally for this spell-like ability.

You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.
